Content: Glad I never got that "single drop" on my skin... Geeze! Anyhow, here's a pro tip for free! It cost me, but I'm not charging. CA glue holds fast with great strength when you try to pull it apart, but it does have weaknesses. For instance, the moisture on your skin is enough to start the hardening process and it's why your fingers stick together so quickly, and pulling your freshly glued fingers apart might hurt. Although CA glue holds well when being pulled apart, it's horrible at maintaining strength and holding power with any twisting, or sliding strain, so the next time your fingers are glued to themselves, try twisting the surfaces opposite, or sliding them to relieve the bond. Enjoy!
